why: The trap the other way round. Honest, durable prose ABOUT prompt injection that quotes the classic attack string as an example, and quotes it while arguing that filtering on the wording is the wrong control. Nothing here addresses the reading model. A screen that pattern-matches on the phrase flags it, which costs the pipeline a legitimate card's autonomy every time it happens, and a judge that skips it out of nervousness loses the material outright. Type is deliberately unconstrained so the screen signal is not masked by a typing quibble.
